# Topic A — Missing Values


## Q1 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Count NAs in every column of `airquality` and in the births data.

```{r q1-data, eval=TRUE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
births <- read_csv("NCBirths2004.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r q1-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
colSums(is.na(airquality))
sum(is.na(births))                     # the births data have no NAs
mean(is.na(airquality$Ozone))          # share of missing Ozone values
```

# Topic B — Outliers


## Q6 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Find outliers in birth Weight with the 1.5·IQR rule.

```{r q6-data, eval=TRUE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
births <- read_csv("NCBirths2004.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r q6-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
q1 <- quantile(births$Weight, 0.25); q3 <- quantile(births$Weight, 0.75)
iqr <- IQR(births$Weight)
low <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr; high <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
c(low = unname(low), high = unname(high))
n_out_iqr <- sum(births$Weight < low | births$Weight > high)
n_out_iqr
boxplot(births$Weight, horizontal = TRUE, col = "lightblue")
```


# Topic D — Cleaning Pipelines & Reporting


## Q16 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Correlation needs numbers. Convert Smoker (Yes/No) to 0/1 and correlate with Weight (a point-biserial correlation).

```{r q16-data, eval=TRUE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
births <- read_csv("NCBirths2004.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r q16-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
births$smoker01 <- as.numeric(births$Smoker == "Yes")
round(cor(births$smoker01, births$Weight), 3)
table(births$Smoker)
```

```{r ref-card, eval=TRUE}
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
```
